message.content: An illustration on a magazine cover depicts a person in a suit facing a rainstorm. The person, from the thighs up, wears a grey patterned suit and a red tie. Their head is tilted back, eyes closed, as white droplets splatter against their face and body. They grip the handle of a broken, white umbrella with a blue logo and the word "Jiwasraya" on it. The umbrella’s fabric is torn and its ribs are bent. Bright white, jagged lines resembling electricity crackle around the person and the umbrella. The background consists of dark, cloudy skies and streaks of rain. Large red text in the upper left reads "PRAHARA JIWASRAYA." Below this, smaller white text states: "AKIBAT SALAH INVESTASI, ASURANSI JIWASRAYA BERPOTENSI MERUGI RATUSAN MILIAR RUPIAH. KORUPSI ATAU SALAH URUS?" At the top, the word "TEMPO" is written in large grey letters. Smaller text at the very top reads "BEREBUT PEMILIH MILENNIAL" and "SUARA SUMBANG RUU PERMUSIKAN." A barcode and date "11-17 FEBRUARI 2019" are in the bottom right.
